product_offering.core_offering: Sardine sells a unified B2B SaaS agentic risk platform that consolidates fraud prevention, AML compliance, real-time transaction monitoring, KYC/KYB onboarding, and credit underwriting for banks, fintechs, marketplaces, payments providers, and crypto businesses. Customers access the platform via API and integrate it into onboarding, payment, and case-management workflows; Fortune 500 customers are cited as having consolidated 11 risk vendors into Sardine, with the platform screening $1.48 trillion in payments across 450+ enterprise customers in 70 countries.
product_offering.differentiator: Unified agentic risk platform spanning KYC, KYB, fraud, AML, credit underwriting, and case management on a single rules/ML engine; proprietary device intelligence, behavioral biometrics, True Piercing™ VPN/proxy unmasking, and connections-graph analytics; cross-industry data consortium (Sardine + Sonar) profiling billions of devices and hundreds of millions of consumers/businesses; task-specific agentic AI agents (OSINT, Graph Analyst, Sanctions, Disputes, Anomaly Detection) automating investigations and rule optimization; Agentic Oversight Framework with explainable decisions for regulator-readiness.
product_offering.functional_benefit: Real-time fraud and AML detection across onboarding, payments, and account lifecycles; reduction in false positives and manual review queues (e.g., 98% reduction in manual reviews at Raise, 95% KYC alerts auto-resolved); higher approval rates and revenue capture (e.g., 70% approval rate increase at Prezzee); faster entity research (90% faster) and KYB; ability to consolidate 11 risk vendors into one platform.
product_offering.problem_solved: Detecting and stopping fraud, scams, and money laundering in real time across onboarding, payments, and account lifecycles; reducing false positives and manual review workload for fraud and AML teams; automating KYC/KYB/AML compliance while meeting regulatory obligations; consolidating multiple risk vendors into a single agentic platform; protecting against AI-driven and agentic attacks.

product_offering.product_overview: Sardine is an agentic risk platform — branded as the "Agentic Financial Crime Platform for Fraud Prevention & AML" — offered as a unified platform composed of modular products spanning four solution pillars: Onboarding (Global KYC, Global KYB, Identity Verification, Document Verification, Bank Verification, Credit Underwriting), Fraud Prevention (Agentic Fraud Ops, Device & Behavior, Payment Fraud, Bank Transactions, Card Issuing Fraud, Merchant Monitoring, Policy Abuse, Refund Fraud), Cyber Security (Account Takeovers, Bot Detection, Job Applicant Fraud), and AML Compliance (Agentic AML Ops, Transaction Monitoring, Customer Risk Rating, Sanctions Screening, Case Management, Sponsor Banking). These modules run on shared platform infrastructure including a Rules Engine, Machine Learning models, a Connections Graph, Consortium Data via Sonar, a Fraud Dashboard, and AI Agents (OSINT Search Agent, Data Analyst Agent, Rule Assistant Agent, Transaction Monitoring Agent, Business Due Diligence Agent, Doc KYC Agent, PEP Screening Agent, Graph Analyst Agent, Sanctions Screening Agent) that automate risk operations end-to-end. Per the company's own site, Fortune 500 customers have consolidated 11 risk vendors into Sardine, and the platform serves 450+ enterprise customers, screens $1.48T in payments, and profiles 6.21B devices.
